q: Is switching from a coal or oil boiler to an electric boiler a green loan project?
title: Electric boiler switch: green loan readiness
short: It can be, but show the numbers both ways. Fuel emissions disappear from Scope 1, while electricity adds Scope 2 at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh on the Indian grid. With grid power alone the net cut may be small or negative; with solar or green open access it is large.
audience: Units replacing fuel-fired boilers or thermic heaters

ul: Fuel invoices and boiler log for 12 months.
Steam or heat output, if metered.
Electricity bills including the new load.
Renewable supply contract or solar generation log, if used.

p: An honest net figure. Lenders and reviewers check that the project lowers total emissions, not just moves them from Scope 1 to Scope 2.

example.title: Worked example
lines: Furnace oil boiler: 4,000 L a month x 2.97 kg = 11.9 t CO2
Electric boiler for the same heat: about 40,000 kWh x 0.710 kg = 28.4 t CO2 on grid power
With green open access power: Scope 2 market-based falls close to zero
example.note: Illustrative. Work out heat demand from your own steam records.

senseible: Senseible measures your baseline from your own bills before the project and keeps measuring after it, so the saving you show a lender comes from documents, not a brochure. Lenders decide on the loan.

sources.label: Loan Market Association, Green Loan and Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles
